mode_reason: 95 RTC is verified received, but 399 RTC of viable fixed-value submissions remain unadjudicated; maintainer adjudication is the binding constraint and no fixed-value work is currently accepted/queued or pending on-chain.

enter_settlement_adjudication_if: accepted_queued is overdue relative to authoritative settlement guidance
return_to_production_if_any: new pending_on_chain or received evidence demonstrates settlement is moving
submitted_to_accepted imbalance falls to <= 3x and recent adjudication velocity is positive
a new candidate clears the elevated build gate with materially superior expected collected RTC/hour

full_rescan_allowed_when: canonical inventory is stale or missing

recheck_triggers.never: terminal: awarded, expired, cap consumed, superseded, or permanently ineligible
recheck_triggers.route_change: revisit only if required write/publication/hardware/account route becomes executable
recheck_triggers.competitor_change: revisit only if occupying implementation is rejected or closes without award
recheck_triggers.maintainer_update: revisit only if reward, cap, assignment, acceptance criteria, or submission route materially changes
recheck_triggers.date_trigger: revisit only on or after the stored date

required: recent acceptance or settlement evidence for similar route
expected collected RTC/hour materially exceeds additional receivable work
does not add disproportionate adjudication burden

scoring.net_value_rule: expected_collected_value minus authorized monetary cost equivalent

resume_if: exceptionally distinct high-confidence finding clears adjudication-cost penalty
